verdict.rationale: Evidence covers agent-side integrations (agent wallets, agent cards, x402/MPP payment flows, agent checkouts) but nothing documents a merchant-facing onboarding step — no setting to enable, agreement to sign, or endpoint-publishing guide aimed at merchants who want to accept agent traffic. The 'buy from any merchant' framing implies merchants need no explicit action, but this is never documented as a self-serve merchant enablement path.
